subject: Toolchain validation & change journal request (Crescent audit)
messages:
From: Alex Miller <alex.miller@crescentaudit.com>
To: hannah.schmitt@redwood.com
Cc: compliance@crescentaudit.com
Date: Fri, 15 Sep 2028 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Toolchain validation artifacts request

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for taking the time on the intake call earlier. To complete our CAIQ/SIG refresh for your account we need a compact set of artifacts demonstrating your secure SDLC controls for the last 12 months. Specifically we need:

- A representative code-review sample that shows PR gating, reviewer attestations, and merge approvals.
- CI/CD gate logs that show the PR->merge->deploy pipeline (timestamped) and any automated policy failures.
- The secrets management policy plus a small redacted export demonstrating ephemeral token rotation or vault usage.
- A change journal (chronological) for system-level deployments or production-impacting changes (last 12 months).

Preferred formats: archive for code-review (zip), CSV or ndjson for CI/change logs, and PDF for policy. If you already have a Drive folder or Jira ticket we can reference that instead of separate attachments.

Can you confirm a delivery ETA? We typically ask for these within 5 business days of request.

Best,
Alex Miller
Security Assessor
Crescent Audit

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: jordan.blake@redwood.com, jasmine.liu@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 15 Sep 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Toolchain validation artifacts request

Jordan / Jasmine —

Crescent is asking for a compact proof bundle (code-review sample, CI gate logs, secrets policy + redacted evidence, change journal). Can we assemble this from our existing evidence artifacts and deliver within 5 business days? Things to coordinate:

- Jordan: can you pull a 10-PR sample export from GitHub that includes review history and merge approvals? Prefer a zip with PR diffs + metadata.
- Jasmine: can you export the CI gate events (last 3 quarters) and include our policy-fail events redacted for PII? Also attach the current secrets policy PDF and a short redaction sample showing vault usage.
- I'll consolidate and upload to a Drive folder and open SEC-8342 for tracking.

Let's aim for EOD Wed 2028-09-19. If any blocker, flag here so I can escalate to Security Ops.

Thanks —
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Security Compliance (interim)
Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: hannah.schmitt@redwood.com, jasmine.liu@redwood.com
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 19 Sep 2028 13:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Deliverable: toolchain evidence package

Hannah / Jasmine,

Attached is the initial package I compiled based on the checklist:

Attachments:
- code-review-sample-2028-08.zip (contains 10 redacted PR exports, reviewer emails, merge timestamps)
- ci-gate-export-2028Q3.csv (PR -> pipeline -> deploy events)
- secret-policy-redaction.pdf (current policy with examples redacted)
- change-journal-2028-09.ndjson (chronological change entries for production-impacting changes)

Notes / redactions:
- Sensitive IP removed from PR diffs; commit SHAs redacted to prefix-only.
- CI logs include runner IDs obfuscated; timestamps maintained.
- Secrets proof: we included a short sample showing vault rotation metadata (no raw secrets).

Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3CrescentToolchainFolder
Jira: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-8342

If Crescent wants a different export format for any item (e.g., full GitHub audit log vs PR zip), let me know and I can add it.

-jordan
Jordan Blake
Principal Engineer, Platform
Redwood Inference
From: Alex Miller <alex.miller@crescentaudit.com>
To: hannah.schmitt@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 19 Sep 2028 21:03:00 +00:00
Subject: Re: Toolchain validation artifacts request

Hannah,

Received the package — thanks for the quick turnaround. A couple quick clarifications after a brief scan:

- In the CI export (ci-gate-export-2028Q3.csv) can you confirm whether ephemeral runner tokens are rotated per job or per day? We saw the rotation metadata but need confirmation of sampling frequency.
- In the change journal one entry references an emergency rollback on 2028-05-03; can you point to the deploy ID or runbook entry for that rollback (if available)?

If you can drop answers in-thread or attach the small snippets we can close the items. Otherwise the artifacts look suitable for CAIQ mapping.

Thanks,
Alex

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Alex Miller <alex.miller@crescentaudit.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Sep 2028 21:45:00 +00:00
Subject: Re: Toolchain validation artifacts request

On Tue, 19 Sep 2028 at 21:03 Alex Miller <alex.miller@crescentaudit.com> wrote:
> Hannah,
> 
> Received the package — thanks for the quick turnaround. A couple quick clarifications after a brief scan:
> 
> - In the CI export (ci-gate-export-2028Q3.csv) can you confirm whether ephemeral runner tokens are rotated per job or per day? We saw the rotation metadata but need confirmation of sampling frequency.
> - In the change journal one entry references an emergency rollback on 2028-05-03; can you point to the deploy ID or runbook entry for that rollback (if available)?

Hi Alex — quick answers:

- Runner tokens: rotated per job by our ephemeral-runner automation; rotation timestamp is recorded on each job event (see field runner_token_rotated_at in the CSV). We sample a 1% job set for independent verification quarterly.
- Rollback 2028-05-03: deploy ID RB-20280503-7; runbook excerpt uploaded to the Drive folder under /runbooks/rollback-RB-20280503.pdf.

If you need a short signed attestation from Security Ops for the rotation sampling, I can request that and append it.

Best,
Hannah
Head of Security Compliance (interim)
Redwood Inference
